candidate: User-supplied tomato context reuses the frozen 177-label network and normalizes its scores over all ten ordered tomato conditions.

confirmation.data: Use a newly registered source with screened original single-label photos. Require at least 25 compatible reference photos for each of early blight, late blight, and healthy. All ten tomato outputs stay eligible in the context policy.
confirmation.compare: Compute automatic and user-supplied macro-F1 on identical photo IDs, averaging the represented classes. Track correctness, early-to-late and late-to-early errors, and all crop errors separately.

activation: Keep automatic 177-label mode and the deployed confidence display unchanged. Tomato requires explicit confirmation. Display context scores as uncalibrated conditional scores. Preserve the existing behavior for all other models.
restriction: An already opened course or follow-up evaluation may not select this candidate or qualify it for deployment.
